basic.name: 普通攻击：骑士斗技
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害；
第四段攻击发动时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动[特殊技：动力压制]消耗生命值减少50%；
招式命中敌人时，少量回复生命值。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG.
During the 4th hit, press [Special Attack] to use Special Attack: Drive Suppression, reducing HP consumption by 50%.
Restores a small amount of HP on hit.

special.name: 特殊技：动力压制
special.trigger: 自身生命值大于25%时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.triggerEn: When HP is above 25%, press [Special Attack] to activate:
special.description:
自身生命值大于25%时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
消耗等同于自身16%生命值上限的生命值，召出摩托快速撞向敌人，持续造成物理伤害；
招式发动短时间内，若为当前操作中的角色时受到敌人攻击，则会触发格挡，免疫该次攻击，并回复5点[决意]；
触发格挡后，立即衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]；
招式持续攻击一段时间后会自动衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
When HP is above 25%, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Consumes HP equal to 16% of Max HP to summon a motorcycle and swiftly crash into enemies, continuously dealing Physical DMG.
If attacked by an enemy as the active character shortly upon activating this skill, triggers a block, negating the attack and restoring 5 Determination.
After triggering a block, immediately chains into EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie.
After the skill continues for a while, it automatically chains into EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：孤轮特技
ex.trigger: [特殊技：动力压制]达到最大攻击时长或触发格挡时自动发动：
ex.triggerEn: Triggers automatically when Special Attack: Drive Suppression reaches its maximum duration or a block is triggered:
ex.description:
[特殊技：动力压制]达到最大攻击时长或触发格挡时自动发动：
将摩托车抬起攻击敌人，造成物理伤害；
招式命中敌人后，额外回复8点[决意]；
招式发动后，若闪能足够，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以衔接[强化特殊技：摇曳步伐]；
招式动作结束后，自动衔接[特殊技：脱缰]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
Triggers automatically when Special Attack: Drive Suppression reaches its maximum duration or a block is triggered:
Lifts the motorcycle to attack enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
On hit, restores an additional 8 Determination.
After using this skill, with enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork.
After the skill animation ends, automatically chains into Special Attack: Run Wild.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：决斗之王
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前使用手炮轰击，造成物理伤害；
若通过[极限闪避]发动该招式，则该招式命中敌人时，回复自身10%生命值上限的生命值，并可以衔接第四段[普通攻击：骑士斗技]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon, dealing Physical DMG.
If this skill is triggered via a Perfect Dodge, hitting an enemy restores 10% of Max HP, and it can be chained into the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Knight's Technique.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：骑士漫步
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动时，回复15点[决意]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gains 15 Determination.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：骑士飞踢
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:

跃至空中朝目标进行飞踢攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Leaps into the air and delivers a flying kick at the target, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.nameEn: Quick Assist: Starlight - Power of Bonds

Fires a blast from his arm cannon ahead, dealing Physical DMG. When HP is above 25%, this skill is replaced with Special Attack: Drive Suppression. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：英雄登台
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
星徽·比利会额外根据自身最大生命值提高贯穿力，每1点最大生命值将提高0.1点贯穿力；发动招式造成的物理伤害均为贯穿伤害，无视敌人防御，使用贯穿力作为招式伤害倍率；
星徽·比利进入战场时即可回复60点闪能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次;
生命值大于25%时，可以点按 【特殊技键】 消耗生命值发动[特殊技：动力压制]，且接战状态下，每次发动该招式时，自身暴击伤害提升90%，持续45秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；生命值小于或等于25%时，受到的伤害减少50%；
星徽·比利攻击命中敌人时，会获得[决意]，回复量根据招式变化，[决意]上限为120点，处于接战状态下，会缓慢回复[决意]；[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]命中时、发动[连携技：骑士漫步]时或触发格挡时，额外回复[决意]；任意方式触发[极限闪避]时，回复3点[决意]，此效果0.5秒内最多触发一次；
当[决意]大于等于100点时，长按 【普通攻击键】 会消耗100点[决意]发动[普通攻击：最高马力星光]；
[普通攻击：骑士斗技]命中敌人时，回复少量生命值；通过[极限闪避]发动[闪避反击：决斗之王]命中敌人时，回复生命值；发动[强化特殊技：抓地轮毂]或[强化特殊技：摇曳步伐]时，回复生命值。
facts.textEn:
Starlight - Billy gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1. All Physical DMG Starlight - Billy deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
Starlight - Billy restores 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When his HP is greater than 25%, press [Special Attack] to consume HP and activate Special Attack: Drive Suppression. While in combat, each use of this skill increases his CRIT DMG by 90% for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When HP is at or below 25%, the DMG he takes is reduced by 50%.
Starlight - Billy gains Determination when his attacks hit enemies, with the amount depending on the skill used. Determination regenerates slowly while in combat, and is capped at 120. Hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, activating Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger, or triggering a block restores additional Determination. Triggering a Perfect Dodge by any means restores 3 Determination. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s.
When Determination is greater than or equal to 100, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 100 Determination and activate Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight.
Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Knight's Technique restores a small amount of HP. Hitting an enemy with Dodge Counter: Duel King activated through a Perfect Dodge restores HP. Using EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels or EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork restores HP.

cinema.name: 英雄登场
cinema.description: [核心被动：骑士决心]进入战场时，额外回复60点闪能；[强化特殊技]命中敌人时，使自身攻击造成的伤害无视目标18%物理伤害抗性，持续45秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: Core Passive: Knight's Resolve restores an additional 60 Adrenaline upon entering the battlefield. Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack causes Starlight - Billy's DMG to ignore 18% Physical RES for 45s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

cinema.name: 荒原机兵
cinema.description: [普通攻击：最高马力星光]、[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]和[终结技：骑士飞踢]造成的伤害提升50%；发动[强化特殊技：摇曳步伐]、[强化特殊技：抓地轮毂]时或发动[特殊技：动力压制]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，获得[涡轮增压]效果：[特殊技：动力压制]会消耗该效果直接衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]，并使该次[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]造成的暴击伤害提升50%，[涡轮增压]效果至多叠加1层。
cinema.descriptionEn: Increases the DMG dealt by Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight, EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, and Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick by 50%. Activating EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork, EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels, or hitting a Stunned enemy with Special Attack: Drive Suppression grants the Turbocharged effect: Special Attack: Drive Suppression consumes this effect to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of Turbocharged can be held.

cinema.name: 骑士精神
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 审判底火
cinema.description: 接战状态下，每次发动[特殊技：动力压制]时，自身暴击伤害提升8%，至多叠加2层，持续45秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；若生命值低于35%，且自身非当前操作中的角色时，会持续回复生命值至35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in combat, each use of Special Attack: Drive Suppression increases Starlight - Billy's CRIT DMG by 8%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If HP is below 35% and Starlight - Billy is not the active character, he continuously recovers HP, up to 35%.

cinema.name: 辉光武装
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 星徽骑士
cinema.description: [终结技：骑士飞踢]和[普通攻击：最高马力星光]造成的贯穿伤害提升18%；第四段[普通攻击：骑士斗技]、[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]或[连携技：骑士漫步]命中敌人后，可以获得1层[煊赫星辉]，最多获得6层，同一招式内至多获得1层；发动[终结技：骑士飞踢]或[普通攻击：最高马力星光]时，至多消耗2层[煊赫星辉]，每消耗1层[煊赫星辉]，使该招式的最后一击额外造成100%贯穿力的物理伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick and Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight's Sheer DMG increases by 18%. Landing the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Knight's Technique, EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie, or Chain Attack: Knight's Swagger grants 1 stack of Brilliant Starlight, stacking up to 6 times, and gaining at most 1 stack per skill use. When using Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick or Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight, consumes up to 2 stacks of Brilliant Starlight, with each stack consumed causing that skill's final hit to deal 100% Sheer Force as additional Physical DMG.

basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Performs a quick forward slash, dealing Physical DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：动力压制
ex.description:
自身生命值大于25%时，点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
消耗等同于自身16%生命值上限的生命值，召出摩托快速撞向敌人，持续造成物理伤害；
招式发动短时间内，若为当前操作中的角色时受到敌人攻击，则会触发格挡，免疫该次攻击，并回复5点[决意]；
触发格挡后，立即衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]；
招式持续攻击一段时间后会自动衔接[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
When HP is above 25%, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Consumes HP equal to 16% of Max HP to summon a motorcycle and swiftly crash into enemies, continuously dealing Physical DMG.
If attacked by an enemy as the active character shortly upon activating this skill, triggers a block, negating the attack and restoring 5 Determination.
After triggering a block, immediately chains into EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie.
After the skill continues for a while, it automatically chains into EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：脱缰
ex.description:
[闪避：银河横行]中断时自动发动：
将摩托车踢向敌人，造成物理伤害；
招式发动后，可以衔接[闪避反击：决斗之王]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Triggers automatically when Dodge: Through the Galaxy is interrupted:
Kicks his motorcycle at enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, it can be chained into Dodge Counter: Duel King.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：孤轮特技
ex.description:
[特殊技：动力压制]达到最大攻击时长或触发格挡时自动发动：
将摩托车抬起攻击敌人，造成物理伤害；
招式命中敌人后，额外回复8点[决意]；
招式发动后，若闪能足够，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 可以衔接[强化特殊技：摇曳步伐]；
招式动作结束后，自动衔接[特殊技：脱缰]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
Triggers automatically when Special Attack: Drive Suppression reaches its maximum duration or a block is triggered:
Lifts the motorcycle to attack enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
On hit, restores an additional 8 Determination.
After using this skill, with enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to chain into EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork.
After the skill animation ends, automatically chains into Special Attack: Run Wild.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：抓地轮毂
ex.description:
闪能足够时，长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用摩托下砸，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时，回复自身30%生命值上限的生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Adrenaline, hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Slams down with the motorcycle, dealing Physical DMG.
Restores 30% of Max HP upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：摇曳步伐
ex.description:
发动[强化特殊技：孤轮特技]后，且闪能足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用摩托和手炮进行混合攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动时，回复自身15%生命值上限的生命值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
After activating EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie and with enough Adrenaline, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Uses the motorcycle and hand cannon for a combined attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, restore 15% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：骑士飞踢
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
跃至空中朝目标进行飞踢攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Leaps into the air and delivers a flying kick at the target, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：星徽-羁绊之力
quickAssist.nameEn: Quick Assist: Starlight - Power of Bonds
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前使用手炮轰击，造成物理伤害；
生命值大于25%时，发动该招式改为发动[特殊技：动力压制]，该效果每5秒至多生效1次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Fires a blast from his arm cannon ahead, dealing Physical DMG. When HP is above 25%, this skill is replaced with Special Attack: Drive Suppression. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
